text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Lansoprazole is not removed from the circulation by hemodialysis. In one reported overdose, a patient consumed 600 mg of lansoprazole with no adverse reaction. Oral lansoprazole doses up to 5000 mg/kg in rats (approximately 1600 times the 30 mg human dose based on BSA) and in mice (about 800 times the 30 mg human dose based on BSA) did not produce deaths or any clinical signs.
